newsitem.title: THAILAND: Securities One clarifies FAS tender.
newsitem.headline: Securities One clarifies FAS tender.

text.p: Thai broker Securities One Plc said in a statement issued on Tuesday it had amended a tender offer for shares of First Asia Securities Plc.

Securities One said it will offer First Asia shareholders a single Securities One common share for every two First Asia Securities shares they hold. It will further offer a single Securities One share for every four First Asia Securities Plc warrants investors hold.
Securities One announced plans to merge with First Asia Securities Plc in April last year.
Thai market regulators have already granted First Asia Securities Plc provisional permission to delist its shares once the merger is complete.
Securities One is to issue 2,692,023 new shares to reserve for the conversion of FAS shares and warrants, the statement said.
At their April 4 meeting Securities One shareholders also resolved to pay a 0.60 baht per share dividend for the second half 1996, the statement said. ($1 = 26 baht)
